name: AmazonPublisherServicesPubmaticAdapter
summary: APS PubMatic Adapter for integrating Amazon Publisher Services with PubMatic SDK
description:
The Amazon Publisher Services PubMatic Adapter enables publishers to use APS demand with PubMatic mediation.
This adapter allows you to integrate Amazon demand into your PubMatic waterfall.
Learn more at: https://aps.amazon.com/aps/solutions-for-mobile-app-developers/
